gen-gf-unica-one-gf-aclonica: Commanding up top, Unica One draws its lines like a marker held at one angle. Aclonica below is a plain sans with a deep lowercase and generous letter spacing, and that stretched, mild-shifting line is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-allerta: Allerta takes the text with a tall x-height and loosely tracked letters, easy to follow. Unica One's headings, with every stroke the same width and plenty of daylight inside the curves, sit above it with a firm, distinctive voice.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alumni-sans: Unica One sets round letters whose rims match their stems, bold and unmistakable. Alumni Sans follows with short ascenders, a wide-open c and quiet swings in stroke weight, so a long passage would feel restful.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alumni-sans-pinstrip: Chunky, confident and uniform: Unica One opens with a huge lowercase and curves you can see right through, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe tightens the word texture below. The sans pushes small capitals against oversized lowercase.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Horizontals as heavy as the verticals give Unica One its blunt, distinctive look. And Alumni Sans SC, a sans-serif with oversized lowercase against small capitals and a squeezed, contemporary texture, sits next to it as the tighter, slightly more modulated voice.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anaheim: Unica One draws every curve with no calligraphic shading, so its headings stay blunt and commanding. But Anaheim, a sans-serif with rounded forms and dense, capital-like lowercase, is the one built to carry the running text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-arsenal: Commanding and a little stubborn, Unica One draws like a marker nib that ignores direction, with big open lowercase curves. Arsenal's near-cap-height lowercase and subtle stroke modulation make a longer read go smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-basic: Unica One draws its commanding headings with a ruler-like constant line and big open curves, nothing like Basic's gentle shifts. Basic, a sans-serif, can stay modest in size.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cal-sans: Big-eyed, uniform and bold, Unica One goes first. Cal Sans, a plain sans with short ascenders and a tall x-height, follows in a single stroke width, so the two feel modern and friendly together.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-carlito: Carlito reads clearly with open round letters, tight spacing and small-looking capitals beside big lowercase. Under Unica One's constant-width, commanding headings, a longer passage would feel compact and modern.
